title: Message/set process_create: build response from locals, not DB re-read
description: process_create builds the response Message struct from local variables rather than re-reading from the DB after commit. This is correct: a post-commit DB read failure would return notCreated while the message is already committed, causing the client to retry and create a duplicate. A future contributor may suggest adding a 'get the real stored object for accuracy' re-read — this would reintroduce the duplicate-creation risk and should be rejected. The locally-constructed Message is authoritative because insert_outbound_message is atomic.
